weather.label: Real weather
weather.description: The clouds under the wing follow the weather where the flight is (Open-Meteo, over Wi-Fi).

eggs.label: Surprises
eggs.description: Now and then something that has no business up there drifts past the window.

sky.label: True sun and moon
sky.description: Off: the sun and the moon are in the window whenever they are above the horizon. On: only when they really stand on your side of the aircraft, where they stand.

reset.label: Start over
reset.description: Flip this switch to clear everything this app has kept. Each flip starts over once. Cannot be undone.
